spells.name: Acid Grip
entries: An ephemeral, taloned hand grips the target, burning it with magical acid. The target takes 2d8 acid damage plus 1d6 {@condition Persistent Damage||persistent acid damage} depending on its Reflex save. A creature taking persistent damage from this spell takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and full persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice.
The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Aerial Form
entries: You harness your mastery of the sky to reshape your body into a Medium flying animal battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as an owl or eagle for bird), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the {@trait Animal||animal} trait. You can Dismiss the spell.
You gain specific abilities based on the animal you choose:
AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
5 temporary Hit Points.
Low-light vision.

One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +16, and your damage bonus is +5. These attacks are Dexterity based (for the purpose of the {@condition Clumsy||clumsy} condition, for example). If your attack modifier for Dexterity-based unarmed attacks is higher, you can use it instead.
{@skill Acrobatics|} modifier of +16, unless your own is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the form you choose:
{@b Bat} Speed 20 feet, fly 30 feet; precise echolocation 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} fangs, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} wing (agile), {@b Damage} 2d6 bludgeoning.
{@b Bird} Speed 10 feet, fly 50 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} beak, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} talon (agile), {@b Damage} 1d10 slashing.
{@b Pterosaur} Speed 10 feet, fly 40 feet; imprecise scent 30 feet; Melee {@as 1} beak, Damage 3d6 piercing.
{@b Wasp} Speed 20 feet, fly 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} stinger, {@b Damage} 1d8 piercing plus 1d6 persistent poison.
Your battle form is Large and your fly Speed gains a +10-foot status bonus. You instead gain 10 temporary HP, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +8, and Acrobatics +20.

Your battle form is Huge, your fly Speed gains a +15-foot status bonus, and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary HP, attack modifier +21, damage bonus +4 and double damage dice (including persistent damage), and Acrobatics +23.

spells.name: Agile Feet
spells.duration: until the end of the current turn
entries: The blessings of your god make your feet faster and your movements more fluid. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed and ignore difficult terrain. As part of casting agile feet, you can Step, Stride, or {@action Tumble Through|}; you can instead {@action Burrow|}, {@action Climb|}, {@action Fly|}, or {@action Swim|} if you have the appropriate Speed.

spells.name: Air Bubble
spells.trigger: A creature within range enters an environment where it can't breathe.
entries: A bubble of pure air appears around the target's head, allowing it to breathe normally. The effect ends as soon as the target returns to an environment where it can breathe normally.

spells.name: Alarm
entries: You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the {@trait Mental||mental} trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the {@trait Auditory||auditory} trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a DC 15 Perception check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a {@skill Stealth|} check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.
You can specify a trigger for which types of creatures sound the alarm spell, as described in Setting Triggers on page 303.

spells.name: Allegro
entries: You perform rapidly, speeding up your ally. The ally becomes quickened and can use the additional action to Strike, Stride, or Step.

spells.name: Animal Feature
entries: Without fully transforming your body, you gain one animalistic feature, which you select from the list below each time you Cast the Spell.
{@b Cat Eyes} You gain low-light vision.
{@b Claws} You gain a claw attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
{@b Jaws} You gain a jaws attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and has the unarmed trait.
Add the following options to the list.
{@b Fish Tail} You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.
{@b Owl Eyes} You gain darkvision.
{@b Wings} You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

spells.name: Animal Form
entries: You call upon primal energy to transform yourself into a Medium animal battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as lion or snow leopard for cat), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the {@trait Animal||animal} trait. You can Dismiss the spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which animal you choose:
AC = 16 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
5 temporary Hit Points.
Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.

One or more {@trait Unarmed||unarmed} melee attacks specific to your battle form, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +9, and your damage bonus is +1. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the {@condition Enfeebled||enfeebled} condition, for example). If your unarmed attack bonus is higher, you can use it instead.
{@skill Athletics|} modifier of +9, unless your own is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the animal you choose:
{@b Ape} Speed 25 feet, climb 20 feet; Melee {@as 1} fist, Damage 2d6 bludgeoning.
{@b Bear} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} claw (agile), {@b Damage} 1d8 slashing.
{@b Bull} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} horn, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing.
{@b Canine} Speed 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing.
{@b Cat} Speed 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 2d6 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} claw (agile), {@b Damage} 1d10 slashing.
{@b Deer} Speed 50 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} antler, {@b Damage} 2d6 piercing.
{@b Frog} Speed 25 feet, swim 25 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 2d6 bludgeoning; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tongue (reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 2d4 bludgeoning.
{@b Shark} swim 35 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing; breathe underwater but not in air.
{@b Snake} Speed 20 feet, climb 20 feet, swim 20 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} fangs, {@b Damage} 2d4 piercing plus 1d6 poison.
You instead gain 10 temporary HP, AC = 17 + your level, attack modifier +14, damage bonus +5, and Athletics +14.
Your battle form is Large and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You instead gain 15 temporary HP, AC = 18 + your level, attack modifier +16, damage bonus +9, and Athletics +16.

Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, AC = 18 + your level, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +7 and double the number of damage dice, and Athletics +20.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
entries: You offer food, and an ordinary Tiny animal within range approaches to eat it. You imprint the image, direction, and distance of an obvious place or landmark well known to you within the animal. You can also attach a small object or note up to light Bulk to it. The animal does its best to reach the destination; if it makes it there, it waits nearby and allows nonhostile creatures to approach and remove the attached object. The spell ends after the message is delivered or after 24 hours, whichever comes first. If there are no Tiny wild animals in range, the spell is lost.

spells.name: Ant Haul
entries: You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

spells.name: Appearance of Wealth
entries: You create a brief vision of immense wealth filling the spell's area. Each creature within 20 feet of the area that could be enticed by material wealth must attempt a Will saving throw. A creature that enters the area automatically disbelieves the illusion, and disbelieving the illusion ends any {@condition Fascinated||fascinated} condition imposed by the spell. As long as you Sustain the spell, other creatures react to the treasure like they would any other illusion, but they are not at risk of becoming fascinated.
{@b Critical Success} The creature disbelieves the illusion and is unaffected by it.
{@b Success} The creature is fascinated by the wealth until it has completed its first action on its next turn.
{@b Failure} The creature is fascinated by the illusion.

spells.name: Aqueous Orb
entries: A sphere of water 10 feet in diameter forms in an unoccupied space in range, either on the ground or on the surface of a liquid. When you Cast this Spell and each time you Sustain it, you can roll the orb, moving it up to 10 feet along the ground or the surface of a liquid. The orb can move through the spaces of any creatures or obstacles that wouldn't stop the flow of water. It extinguishes non-magical fires it moves through of its size or smaller, and it attempts to counteract any magical fires it moves through. If it fails to counteract a given fire, it can't counteract that fire for the duration of the spell.

The orb can engulf Large or smaller creatures it moves through, and it can contain as many creatures as fit in its space. The orb can try to engulf the same creature only once per turn, even if you roll it onto a creature's space more than once. Any Large or smaller creature whose space the orb tries to move through can attempt a Reflex save.

{@b Success} The creature can either let the orb pass (remaining in its space or moving out of the orb's path into a space of the creature's choice) or allow itself to be pushed in front of the orb to the end of the orb's movement.

{@b Failure} The creature is engulfed in the orb. It moves along with the orb and must hold its breath or begin suffocating (unless it can breathe in water). An engulfed Medium or smaller creature and anyone trying to affect that creature follow the normal rules for aquatic battles. An engulfed Large creature is usually big enough that parts of it stick out from the water, and it can reach out of the water.

The creature can get free either by Swimming with a successful DC 10 {@skill Athletics|} check or by Escaping against your spell DC. A freed creature exits the orb's space and can immediately breathe.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the creature can't Swim to get free.

spells.name: Arctic Rift
entries: A jagged crack opens in the air, dealing 12d8 cold damage as it draws away warmth. Each creature along the rift must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and is {@condition Slowed||slowed 1} until the start of your next turn.

{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage, is {@condition Immobilized||immobilized} by a layer of ice, and is slowed 1 as long as its immobilized. The ice is an object with 60 Hit Points, Hardness 5, immunity to cold damage, and vulnerability 10 to fire. It has object immunities (page 269) and is destroyed if the target Escapes.
The damage increases by 1d8 and the ice's Hit Points increase by 5.

spells.name: Artistic Flourish
spells.targets: 1 item or work of art that fits entirely within the range
entries: You transform the target into a form that more closes matches your creative vision. It's clearly the same item, but with aesthetic details you choose. The target is a beautiful and impressive piece for its new quality, but the effect is obviously magical and temporary, so its monetary value doesn't change. If you're an expert in {@skill Crafting|}, the item grants a +1 item bonus to attack rolls if it's a weapon or skill checks if it's a skill tool. When you Cast this Spell, any previous casting ends.
If you're a master in Crafting, the item grants a +2 item bonus.
If you're legendary in Crafting, the item grants a +3 item bonus.

spells.name: Athletic Rush
entries: Your body fills with physical power and skill. You gain a +10- foot status bonus to Speed and a +2 status bonus to {@skill Athletics|} checks. As a part of Casting this Spell, you can use a Stride, {@action Leap|}, {@action Climb|}, or {@action Swim|} action. The spell's bonuses apply during that action.

spells.name: Augury
entries: You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a {@trait Secret||secret} DC 6 flat check. On a failure, the result is always “nothing.” This makes it impossible to tell whether a “nothing” result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

spells.name: Avatar
entries: You transform into an avatar of your deity, assuming a Huge battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions. You can Dismiss this spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which deity's battle form you assume:
AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
30 temporary Hit Points.
Darkvision.

One or more attacks specific to your deity's battle form, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +33, and you use the listed damage. Melee attacks are Strength based (for the purposes of the {@condition Enfeebled||enfeebled} condition, for example) unless they have the finesse trait, and all ranged attacks are Dexterity based.
{@skill Athletics|} modifier of +35, unless your own is higher.
You also gain the specific abilities listed for your deity below:
{@b Abadar} Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet, immune to {@condition Immobilized||immobilized}; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} crossbow (range increment 120 feet, reload 1), {@b Damage} 6d10+3 piercing.
{@b Asmodeus} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet; Melee {@as 1} mace (reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d10+6 bludgeoning; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} hellfire (range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 fire.

{@b Calistria} Speed 30 feet, fly 70 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} whip (disarm, finesse, {@trait Nonlethal||nonlethal}, reach 20 feet), {@b Damage} 6d4+6 slashing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} savored sting (range 60 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 poison.

{@b Cayden Cailean} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet, ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; {@b Melee} {@as 1} rapier ({@trait Deadly||deadly 3d8}, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+6 piercing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} ale splash (range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 poison.

{@b Desna} Speed 30 feet, fly 70 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} starknife (agile, {@trait Deadly||deadly 3d4}, finesse, reach 15 feet, silver, thrown 60 feet), {@b Damage} 6d4+6 piercing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} moonbeam (range 120 feet, silver), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 fire.

{@b Erastil} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet, ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} longbow ({@trait Deadly||deadly 3d8}, range increment 150 feet), {@b Damage} 6d8+3 piercing.
{@b Gorum} Speed 70 feet, immune to {@condition Immobilized||immobilized}; {@b Melee} {@as 1} greatsword (versatile P, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d12+6 slashing.

{@b Gozreh} no land Speed, fly 70 feet, swim 70 feet, ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; {@b Melee} {@as 1} waves (reach 15 feet, shove, thrown 20 feet), {@b Damage} 6d8+6 bludgeoning; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} wind (versatile electricity, range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 bludgeoning.
{@b Iomedae} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet; shield (Hardness 15, can't be damaged); {@b Melee} {@as 1} longsword (versatile P, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d8+6 slashing.

{@b Irori} Speed 80 feet, fly 80 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} unfettered strike (agile, versatile P or S, finesse, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d8+6 bludgeoning; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} wind strike (range 60 feet), {@b Damage} 6d4+6 bludgeoning.

{@b Lamashtu} Speed 30 feet, fly 70 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} falchion (forceful, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d10+6 slashing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} waters of Lamashtu (range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 poison.
{@b Nethys} Speed 70 feet, fly; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} raw magic (range 120 feet; versatile cold, electricity, or fire), {@b Damage} 6d6 force.

{@b Norgorber} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet, ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; {@b Melee} {@as 1} shortsword (agile, finesse, versatile S, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+6 piercing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} blackfinger toss (range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 poison.

{@b Pharasma} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} dagger (agile, finesse, reach 15 feet, thrown 40 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+6 slashing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} spiral blast (range 120 feet, damages only {@trait Undead||undead}), {@b Damage} 6d8+3 vitality.

{@b Rovagug} Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet, immune to {@condition Immobilized||immobilized}; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws (reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d12+6 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} leg (agile, versatile P, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d8+6 bludgeoning.

{@b Sarenrae} Speed 30 feet, fly 70 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} scimitar (forceful, {@trait Nonlethal||nonlethal}, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+6 slashing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} everflame ({@trait Nonlethal||nonlethal}, range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 fire.

{@b Shelyn} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet, ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; Melee {@as 1} glaive ({@trait Deadly||deadly 3d8}, {@trait Nonlethal||nonlethal}, reach 20 feet), {@b Damage} 6d8+6 slashing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} melody of inner beauty, ({@trait Nonlethal||nonlethal}, range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 sonic.

{@b Torag} Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet, immune to {@condition Immobilized||immobilized}; shield (Hardness 15, can't be damaged); {@b Melee} {@as 1} warhammer (reach 15 feet, shove), {@b Damage} 6d8+6 bludgeoning.

{@b Urgathoa} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet; Melee {@as 1} scythe ({@trait Deadly||deadly 3d10}, trip, reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 6d10+6 slashing; {@b Ranged} {@as 1} pallid plague (range 120 feet), {@b Damage} 6d6+3 void.

{@b Zon-Kuthon} Speed 70 feet, fly 70 feet, ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; {@b Melee} {@as 1} spiked chain (disarm, trip, reach 15 feet), Damage 6d8+6 slashing; Ranged {@as 1} midnight pain ({@trait Mental||mental}, {@trait Nonlethal||nonlethal}, range 120 feet), Damage 6d6+3 mental.

spells.name: Bane
entries: You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw. {@i Bane} can counteract {@spell Bless|PC1|bless}.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.targets: 1 creature that isn't on its home plane
entries: You send the target back to its home plane. The target must attempt a Will save. You can spend an extra action while Casting this Spell and add a cost to the spell to give the creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save. The cost must be a specially gathered object that is anathema to the creature. This spell fails if you aren't on your home plane when you cast it.
{@b Critical Success} The target resists being banished and you are {@condition Stunned||stunned 1}.
{@b Success} The target resists being banished.
{@b Failure} The target is banished.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is banished and can't return by any means to the plane it's banished from for 1 week.
You can target up to 10 creatures. The extra cost affects targets to which it is anathema.

spells.name: Bind Undead
spells.targets: 1 mindless undead creature with a level no greater than {@i bind undead}’s spell rank
entries: With a word of power, you seize control of the target. It gains the {@trait Minion||minion} trait. If you or an ally uses any hostile actions against the target, the spell ends.

spells.name: Bit of Luck
entries: You tilt the scales of luck slightly to protect a creature from disaster. When the target would attempt a saving throw, it can roll twice and use the better result. Once it does this, the spell ends. If you cast {@i bit of luck} again, any previous bit of luck you cast that's still in effect ends. After a creature has been targeted with {@i bit of luck}, it becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

spells.name: Blazing Bolt
entries: You fire a ray of heat and flame. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage, and on a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, you can fire an additional ray at a different target, to a maximum of three rays targeting three different targets for 3 actions.

These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make all the spell attack rolls for blazing bolt. If you spend 2 or more actions Casting the Spell, the damage increases to 4d6 fire damage on a hit, and it still deals double damage on a critical hit.
The damage to each target increases by 1d6 for the 1-action version, or by 2d6 for the 2- and 3-action versions.

spells.name: Bless
entries: Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet. {@i Bless} can counteract {@spell Bane|PC1|bane}.

spells.name: Blessed Boundary
entries: Manifestations of divine force appear in the hundreds, swirling in a massive, protective sphere. These typically look like spiky fragments, but often take on an appearance themed to the deity of the caster. The sphere is hollow, with the manifestations forming a shell 2 inches deep on the outer edge. You can choose to make the burst smaller, in 5-foot increments, when you cast it.

The shell provides cover and can intersect solid terrain without affecting it. The shell deals 7d8 force damage to each creature who intersects with the shell when the sphere's created, or who attempts to move through the shell. The creature also takes the damage at the end of its turn, but only if it didn't already take damage from the shell that turn. The effects are determined by a creature's Reflex save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage, is pushed up to 10 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage, is pushed up to 20 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.
The damage increases by 1d8.

spells.name: Blindness
entries: You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Blinded||blinded} until its next turn begins.
{@b Failure} The target is blinded for 1 minute.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is blinded permanently.

spells.name: Blood Vendetta
spells.trigger: A creature deals piercing, slashing, or persistent bleed damage to you
entries: You curse the target, punishing it for having the audacity to spill your blood. The target takes 2d6 {@condition Persistent Damage||persistent bleed damage} and must attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half the persistent bleed damage.
{@b Failure} The target takes the full persistent bleed damage. Until the bleeding stops, the target has weakness 1 to piercing and slashing damage.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the target takes double the persistent bleed damage.
The persistent bleed damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Blood Ward
entries: Your patron's aegis descends to shield a target from harm. Designate one of the following creature traits: {@trait Aberration||aberration}, {@trait Animal||animal}, {@trait Beast||beast}, {@trait Celestial||celestial}, {@trait Construct||construct}, {@trait Dragon||dragon}, {@trait Elemental||elemental}, {@trait Fey||fey}, {@trait Fiend||fiend}, {@trait Fungus||fungus}, {@trait Monitor||monitor}, {@trait Ooze||ooze}, {@trait Plant||plant}, or {@trait Undead||undead}. The target gains a +1 status bonus to its saving throws and AC against creatures with that trait.
The status bonus increases to +2.

spells.name: Blur
entries: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes {@condition Concealed||concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to {@action Hide|} or {@action Sneak|}.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.trigger: A living creature within range would die
entries: Your blessing revives a creature at the moment of its death. You prevent the target from dying and restore 5d8 Hit Points to the target. You can't use breath of life if the triggering effect was a {@trait Death||death} effect or an effect that leaves no remains, such as {@spell Disintegrate|PC1|disintegrate}.
The healing increases by 1d8.

spells.name: Breathe Fire
entries: A gout of flame sprays from your mouth. You deal 2d6 fire damage to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save.
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Cackle
entries: With a quick burst of laughter, you prolong a magical effect you created. You Sustain a spell.

spells.name: Calm
entries: You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} Calming urges impose a –1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

{@b Failure} Any {@trait Emotion||emotion} effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by {@i calm}.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

spells.name: Canticle of Everlasting Grief
entries: You create a melody distilled from pure grief, conveying the inevitable loss of everything your target cherishes, audible to only them. The target takes 10d6 mental damage depending on its Will save. A creature cursed by this spell can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses, for the duration noted in the degree of success.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half damage, is {@condition Frightened||frightened 1}, and is cursed for 1 round.
{@b Failure} The target takes full damage, is frightened 3, and is cursed for 1 week.

{@b Critical Failure} The target takes double damage, is frightened 4, and is cursed for an unlimited duration. While the curse remains, the target's allies are also affected by the curse while within 15 feet of the creature.

spells.name: Captivating Adoration
entries: You become intensely entrancing, and creatures are distracted by you as long as they remain within the area. You can exclude any creatures you choose from the effects. If a creature is in the aura when you Cast the Spell or when it enters the aura for the first time, it must attempt a Will saving throw. If a creature leaves and reenters, it uses the results of its original save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 hour.
{@b Success} The creature is {@condition Fascinated||fascinated} with you for its next action, then is temporarily immune for 1 hour.
{@b Failure} The creature is fascinated with you.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is fascinated with you, and its attitude toward you improves by one step.
Increase the size of the emanation by 15 feet.

spells.name: Cataclysm
entries: You call upon the unimaginable power of world-ending cataclysms, ripping a small piece of each cataclysm and combining them together into one horrifically powerful attack. The following effects come down upon all creatures in the area. Treat the resistances of creatures in the area as if they were 10 lower for the purpose of determining the cataclysm's damage. Each creature attempts one basic Reflex save that applies to all five types of damage.
Flesh-dissolving acid rain deals 3d10 acid damage.
A roaring earthquake shakes and bludgeons creatures on the ground, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage.
A blast of freezing wind deals 3d10 cold damage.
Incredible lightning lashes the area, dealing 3d10 electricity damage.
Beating winds churn across the sky, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage to creatures flying in the area.
An instant tsunami sweeps over creatures in the area, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage (doubled for creatures swimming in the area).
A massive wildfire burns in a sudden inferno, dealing 3d10 fire damage.

spells.name: Caustic Blast
entries: You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes 1 {@condition Persistent Damage||persistent acid damage}.
The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.targets: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures
entries: You discharge a powerful bolt of lightning at the target, dealing 8d12 electricity damage. The target must attempt a basic Reflex save. The electricity then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the chain at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome). The chain ends if any one of the targets critically succeeds at its save.
The damage increases by 1d12.

spells.name: Charm
entries: To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.
{@b Success} The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of {@i charm}, unless it identifies the spell.
{@b Failure} The target's attitude becomes {@condition Friendly||friendly} toward you. If it was friendly, it becomes {@condition Helpful||helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.
{@b Critical Failure} The target's attitude becomes helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.
The duration lasts until your next daily preparations.
The duration lasts until your next daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

spells.name: Charming Push
spells.duration: until the start of your next turn
entries: You push at the target's mind to deflect their ire. The target must attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls against you.
{@b Failure} The target can't use hostile actions against you.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is {@condition Stunned||stunned 1} and can't use hostile actions against you.

spells.name: Charming Touch
spells.targets: 1 creature that could find you attractive
entries: You infuse your target with attraction, causing it to act friendlier toward you. The target attempts a Will save. It gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this save if you or your allies recently threatened or were hostile to it.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.
{@b Success} The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charming touch, unless it identifies the spell (see Identifying Spells on page 303).

{@b Failure} The target's attitude becomes {@condition Friendly||friendly} toward you. If it was friendly, it becomes {@condition Helpful||helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you. If you use a hostile action against the target, the spell ends. You can Dismiss the spell. After the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations. If it doesn't realize you charmed it, you could potentially convince it to continue being your friend via mundane means.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the target is helpful.

spells.name: Chilling Darkness
entries: You shoot an utterly cold ray of darkness tinged with unholy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 cold damage. If the target has the {@trait Holy||holy} trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.
{@b Critical Success} The target takes double damage.
{@b Success} The target takes full damage.

If the ray passes through an area of magical light or targets a creature affected by magical {@trait Light||light}, {@i chilling darkness} attempts to counteract the light. If you need to determine whether the ray passes through an area of light, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.
The cold damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against holy creatures increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Clairaudience
entries: You create an {@condition Invisible||invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
entries: You create an {@condition Invisible||invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

spells.name: Cleanse Affliction
entries: Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a {@trait Curse||curse}, {@trait Disease||disease}, or {@trait Poison||poison}. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.
Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.
Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

spells.name: Cleanse Cuisine
entries: You transform all food and beverages in the area into delicious fare, changing water into wine or another fine beverage, or enhancing the food's taste and ingredients to make it a gourmet treat. You can also choose to remove all toxins and contaminations from the food. This spell doesn't prevent future contamination, natural decay, or spoilage, nor does it make the food any more nutritious.
Add another cubic foot to the area, which must be contiguous with the rest.

spells.name: Clear Mind
entries: You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: {@condition Fleeing||fleeing}, {@condition Frightened||frightened}, and {@condition Stupefied||stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.
Add {@condition Confused||confused}, {@condition Controlled||controlled}, and {@condition Slowed||slowed} to the list of conditions.
As 4th rank, plus add {@condition Doomed||doomed}.
As 4th rank, plus add {@condition Doomed||doomed} and {@condition Stunned||stunned}.

spells.name: Clinging Ice
entries: Freezing sleet and heavy snowfall collect on the target's feet and legs, dealing 1d4 cold damage and other effects depending on its Reflex save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The target takes full damage and a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the spell ends.
{@b Critical Failure} The target takes double damage and a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the spell ends.
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Cloak of Shadow
entries: You drape the target in a mantle of swirling shadows that make it harder to see. The cloak reduces bright light within a 20-foot emanation to dim light. This is a form of magical {@trait Darkness||darkness} and can therefore overcome non-magical light or attempt to counteract magical light.

The target can use {@condition Concealed||concealed} condition gained from the shadows to {@action Hide|}, though observant creatures can still follow the moving aura of shadow, making it difficult for the target to become completely {@condition Undetected||undetected}. The target can use an {@action Interact|} action to remove the cloak and leave it behind as a decoy, where it remains, reducing light for the rest of the spell's duration. If anyone picks up the cloak after it's been removed by the original target, the cloak evaporates and the spell ends.

spells.name: Command
spells.duration: until the end of the target's next turn
entries: You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the {@condition Fleeing||fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop {@condition Prone||prone}, or stand in place. It can't {@action Delay|} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.
{@b Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The creature must spend the first action on its next turn to obey your command.
{@b Critical Failure} The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.
You can target up to 10 creatures.

spells.name: Commanding Lash
spells.requirements: Your most recent action dealt damage to a target
spells.targets: a creature you dealt damage to on your most recent action
spells.duration: until the end of the target's next turn
entries: With the threat of more pain, you compel a creature you've recently harmed. You issue a command to the target, with the effects of the spell {@spell Command|PC1|command}. If the target is {@condition Frightened||frightened}, {@condition Stupefied||stupefied}, or taking {@condition Persistent Damage||persistent damage}, it takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the save. Regardless of the result, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

spells.name: Community Restoration
spells.trigger: You Cast a Spell from a wizard spell slot, and the spell affects one or more willing allies without damaging them
entries: When you use your magic to support your allies, shared strength bolsters you all. You gain 2 temporary Hit Points per rank of the triggering spell, and can grant an equal number divided as you choose among allies affected by the triggering spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

spells.name: Competitive Edge
entries: Your competitiveness drives you to prove yourself against the opposition. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks. If an enemy within 20 feet critically succeeds at an attack roll or skill check, your status bonus increases to +3 for attack rolls or that specific skill check (whichever the foe critically succeeded at) for 1 round.
Increase the base bonus to +2 and the increased bonus after an enemy critically succeeds to +4.

spells.name: Confusion
entries: You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target babbles incoherently and is {@condition Stunned||stunned 1}.
{@b Failure} The target is {@condition Confused||confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.
You can target up to 10 creatures.

spells.name: Contingency
entries: You prepare a spell that will trigger later. While casting contingency, you also cast another spell of 4th rank or lower with a casting time of no more than 3 actions. This companion spell must be one that can affect you. You must make any decisions for the spell when you cast contingency, such as choosing a damage type for {@spell Resist Energy|PC1|resist energy}. During the casting, choose a trigger under which the spell will be cast, using the same restrictions as for the trigger of a {@action Ready|} action. Once {@i contingency} is cast, you can cause the companion spell to come into effect as a reaction with that trigger. It affects only you, even if it would affect more creatures. If you define complicated conditions, as determined by the GM, the trigger might fail. If you cast {@i contingency} again, the newer casting supersedes the older.
You can choose a spell of 5th rank or lower.
You can choose a spell of 6th rank or lower.
You can choose a spell of 7th rank or lower.

spells.name: Control Water
entries: By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Creatures that have the water trait and that are in the area when you Cast the Spell must attempt a Fortitude save, with the effects of the {@spell Slow|PC1|slow} spell.

spells.name: Cornucopia
entries: Vines twine into a wicker horn in your hands, and out spills a single fruit, nut, or similar small bit of produce. A creature who eats the produce with an Interact action regains 1d6+4 HP. The cornucopia, as well as any unconsumed pieces of fruit, wither away at the end of the duration.

The cornucopia produces an additional piece of food. A creature can consume any amount of food from the same casting with a single Interact action. Eating six pieces of produce from the cornucopia gives as much nourishment as one square meal for a typical human.

spells.name: Counter Performance
spells.trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet rolls a saving throw against an auditory or visual effect
entries: Your performance protects you and your allies. Roll a {@skill Performance|} check for a type you know—it must be an auditory performance if the trigger was auditory or a visual one for a visual trigger, and this action gains the traits for the type of performance. You and allies in the area can use the better result between your Performance check and the saving throw.

spells.name: Courageous Anthem
entries: You inspire yourself and your allies with words or tunes of encouragement. You and all allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against {@trait Fear||fear} effects.

spells.name: Cozy Cabin
entries: You shape a cabin 20 feet on each side and 10 feet high. This cabin has the {@trait Structure||structure} trait and the same restrictions as magic items that create structures. The walls of the hut are simple and wooden, with small, square glass windows, and it has one wooden door. It doesn't include its own lock, but it has a fastener to which a lock can be applied.

The interior contains three cots, one chamber pot, and a small fireplace holding a magical fire. The interior is lit with a small magical light that you can light or extinguish at will using a Sustain action. The climate inside the hut is comfortable and allows creatures inside it to withstand most hostile weather conditions, but incredible heat or cold, powerful storms, and winds of hurricane force or greater destroy the hut. Other creatures can freely enter and exit the hut without damaging it, but if you exit the hut, the spell ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

spells.name: Create Food
entries: You create enough food to feed six Medium creatures for a day. This food is bland and unappealing, but it is nourishing. After 1 day, if no one has eaten the food, it decays and becomes inedible. Most Small creatures eat one-quarter as much as a Medium creature (one-sixteenth as much for most Tiny creatures), and most Large creatures eat 10 times as much (100 times as much for Huge creatures and so on).
You can feed 12 Medium creatures.
You can feed 50 Medium creatures.
You can feed 200 Medium creatures.

spells.name: Create Water
entries: As you cup your hands, water begins to flow forth from them. You create 2 gallons of water. If no one drinks it, it evaporates after 1 day.

spells.name: Creation
entries: You conjure a temporary object from magical energy. It must consist of earthen or plant-derived matter (such as wood, paper, brick, or stone) and be 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, and can't be made of precious materials or materials with a rarity of {@trait Uncommon||uncommon} or higher. It is obviously temporarily conjured, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item. The spell gains the appropriate trait for the item created, typically {@trait Earth||earth}, {@trait Plant||plant}, or {@trait Wood||wood}.
The item is metal and can include common minerals, like feldspar or quartz. The spell gains the {@trait Metal||metal} trait if used to create a metal object.

spells.name: Creative Splash
entries: A deluge of paint or colorful illusions descend on the area, reflecting your personal creative specialty. Roll 1d4 to determine the color of the illusion. Each creature in the area must succeed at a Will save or take the effect listed on the table for the color.

spells.name: Crisis of Faith
entries: You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast {@trait Divine||divine} spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's {@condition Stupefied||stupefied 1} for 1 round.
{@b Critical Failure} The target takes double damage, is stupefied 1 for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.
To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.
The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

spells.name: Cry of Destruction
entries: Your voice booms, smashing what's in front of you. Each creature and unattended object in the area takes 1d8 sonic damage. If you already dealt damage to an enemy this turn with a Strike or spell, increase the damage dice from this spell to d12s.
The damage increases by 1d8.

spells.name: Curse of Death
entries: Your patron wraps a hand around your target's heart. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to all {@i curses of death} for 1 day.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 1, and the stage of the curse can't increase beyond stage 1.
{@b Failure} The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 1.

{@b Critical Failure} The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 2. {@b Curse of Death} ({@trait Curse||curse}, {@trait Death||death}, {@trait Void||void}) This curse ends when the spell ends
{@b Stage 1} 4d6 void damage and {@condition Fatigued||fatigued} (1 round)
{@b Stage 2} 8d6 void damage and fatigued (1 round)
{@b Stage 3} 12d6 void damage and fatigued (1 round)
{@b Stage 4} death
Increase the void damage taken on a success and during the first three stages of the curse by 1d6.

spells.name: Cursed Metamorphosis
entries: You transform the target creature into a harmless animal appropriate to the area, with effects based on its Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.

{@b Success} The target's body gains minor features of the harmless animal. Its insides churn as they partially transform, causing it to be {@condition Sickened||sickened 1}. When it recovers from the sickened condition, its features revert to normal.

{@b Failure} The target transforms for 1 minute but keeps its mind. If it spends all its actions on its turn concentrating on its original form, it can attempt a Will save to end the effect immediately.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is transformed into the chosen harmless animal, body and mind, for an unlimited duration.

spells.name: Darkened Sight
entries: You infuse a creature's vision with darkness. It receives greater darkvision, allowing it to see even in magical darkness.

spells.name: Darkness
entries: You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical {@trait Light||light} of your {@i darkness} spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.
Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as {@condition Concealed||concealed}.

spells.name: Darkvision
entries: You grant yourself supernatural sight in areas of darkness. You gain darkvision.
The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature.
The spell's range is touch and it targets 1 willing creature. The duration is until your next daily preparations.

spells.name: Daze
entries: You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also {@condition Stunned||stunned 1}.
The damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Dazzling Flash
entries: You raise your religious symbol and create a blinding flash of light. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature is {@condition Dazzled||dazzled} for 1 round.
{@b Failure} The creature is {@condition Blinded||blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end the blinded condition.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.
The area increases to a 30-foot cone.

spells.name: Deafness
entries: The target loses its hearing. It must attempt a Fortitude save, and it is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Deafened||deafened} for 1 round.
{@b Failure} The target is deafened for 10 minutes.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is deafened permanently.

spells.name: Death's Call
spells.trigger: A living creature within 20 feet of you dies, or an undead creature within 20 feet of you is destroyed
entries: Seeing another pass from this world invigorates you. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the triggering creature's level plus your spellcasting attribute modifier. If the triggering creature was {@trait Undead||undead}, double the number of temporary Hit Points you gain. These last for the duration of the spell, and the spell ends if all the temporary Hit Points are depleted earlier.

spells.name: Deceiver's Cloak
entries: Your patron drapes a cloak of illusion about you, making you appear as another creature of the same body shape with roughly similar height and weight as yourself. This has the effects of 3rd-rank {@spell Illusory Disguise|PC1|illusory disguise}.
You can appear as any creature of the same size, even with a completely different body shape.

spells.name: Delusional Pride
entries: You make the target overconfident, leading it to ascribe failure to external factors. The target attempts a Will save to determine the spell's duration and is temporarily immune for 24 hours regardless of the save's result.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.

{@b Success} The duration is 1 round. If the target fails at an attack roll or skill check, it takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and skill checks until the end of its turn (or the end of its next turn, if it attempted the roll outside its turn). If the creature fails a second time while taking this penalty, the penalty increases to –2.
{@b Failure} As success, but the duration is 10 minutes.
{@b Critical Failure} As success, but the duration is 24 hours.

spells.name: Desiccate
entries: You pull the moisture from the targets' bodies, dealing 10d10 void damage. Creatures made of water (such as water elementals) and {@trait Plant||plant} creatures use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their saving throw. Creatures whose bodies contain no significant moisture (such as earth elementals) are immune to {@i desiccate}.
The damage increases by 1d10.

spells.name: Destructive Aura
entries: Swirling sands of divine devastation surround you, weakening the defenses of all they touch. Reduce the resistances of yourself and creatures in the area by 2.
Reduce the resistances by an additional 2.

spells.name: Detect Magic
entries: You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect {@trait Illusion||illusion} magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your {@i detect magic} spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an {@i invisibility potion}) typically are detected normally.
You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spells.name: Detect Poison
entries: You detect whether a creature is venomous or poisonous, or if an object is poison or has been poisoned. You do not ascertain whether the target is poisonous in multiple ways, nor do you learn the type or types of poison. Certain substances, like lead and alcohol, are poisons and so mask other poisons.
You learn the number and types of poison.

spells.name: Detect Scrying
entries: By reading trace auras, you detect the presence of {@trait Scrying||scrying} effects in the area. If {@i detect scrying} is higher rank than a scrying effect, you gain a glimpse of the scrying creature and learn its approximate distance and direction.
The duration is until your next daily preparations.

spells.name: Detonate Magic
entries: You cause the magic within the target to dissipate in a destructive explosion. You attempt to counteract the target. If the attempt succeeds, an explosion of magical force deals 8d6 force damage with a basic Reflex save. If you successfully counteract the magic of an item, it's deactivated for 1 week (or destroyed on a critical success) and the explosion is a 5-foot emanation from the item. If you successfully counteract a spell, the effect ends and the explosion affects either all creatures in the spells' area or the target of the spell and all creatures in a 5-foot emanation around it.

spells.name: Dinosaur Form
entries: You channel the primal forces of nature to transform into a Large animal battle form, specifically that of a powerful and terrifying dinosaur. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can decide the specific type of animal, but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the {@trait Animal||animal} and {@trait Dinosaur||dinosaur} traits. You can Dismiss the spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
15 temporary Hit Points.
Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.

One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +16, and your damage bonus is +9. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the {@condition Enfeebled||enfeebled} condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
{@skill Athletics|} modifier of +18, unless your own is higher.
You also gain specific abilities based on the form you choose:
{@b Ankylosaurus} Speed 25 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tail (backswing, reach 10 feet), {@b Damage} 2d6 bludgeoning; {@b Melee} {@as 1} foot, {@b Damage} 2d6 bludgeoning.
{@b Brontosaurus} Speed 25 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tail (reach 15 feet), {@b Damage} 2d6 bludgeoning; {@b Melee} {@as 1} foot, {@b Damage} 2d8 bludgeoning.
{@b Deinonychus} Speed 40 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} talon (agile), {@b Damage} 2d4 piercing plus 1 persistent bleed; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 1d10 piercing.
{@b Stegosaurus} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tail (reach 10 feet), {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing.
{@b Triceratops} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} horn, {@b Damage} 2d8 piercing, plus 1d6 persistent bleed on a critical hit; {@b Melee} {@as 1} foot, {@b Damage} 2d6 bludgeoning.

{@b Tyrannosaurus} Speed 30 feet; {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws ({@trait Deadly||deadly d12}, reach 10 feet), {@b Damage} 1d12 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tail (reach 10 feet), {@b Damage} 1d10 bludgeoning.

Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach, or 20-foot reach if they started with 15-foot reach. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +18, a damage bonus of +6, double the damage dice, and Athletics +21.

Your battle form is Gargantuan and your attacks have 20-foot reach, or 25-foot reach if they started with 15-foot reach. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 25 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +25, a damage bonus of +15, double the damage dice, and Athletics +25.

spells.name: Dirge of Doom
entries: Enemies within the area are {@condition Frightened||frightened 1}. They can't reduce their frightened value below 1 while they remain in the area.

spells.name: Disappearance
entries: You shroud a creature from others' senses. The target becomes {@condition Invisible||invisible}, but not merely to vision. The invisibility granted by {@i disappearance} applies to all precise senses an observer might have. It's still possible for a creature to find the target by Seeking using various senses, looking for disturbed dust, hearing gaps in the sound spectrum, or finding some other way to discover the presence of a creature that is otherwise undetectable.

spells.name: Discern Secrets
entries: Your patron deigns to whisper a few secrets. The target can {@action Recall Knowledge|}, {@action Seek|}, or {@action Sense Motive|} as a free action. The target gains a +1 status bonus to the statistic used for the roll (a skill or Perception) on the roll and as long as you Sustain the spell. The target is temporarily immune to discern secrets for 1 minute.
You can target two creatures instead of one.

spells.name: Disguise Magic
entries: You alter how an item's or spell's magical aura appears to effects like {@spell Detect Magic|PC1|detect magic}. You can hide the auras entirely, have an item register as a common item of lower level, or make a spell register as a common spell of the same or lower rank. You can Dismiss the spell.

A caster using {@i detect magic} or {@spell Read Aura|PC1|read aura} of a higher rank than {@i disguise magic} can attempt to disbelieve the illusion using the skill matching the tradition of the spell ({@skill Arcana|} for {@trait Arcane||arcane}, {@skill Religion|} for {@trait Divine||divine}, {@skill Occultism|} for {@trait Occult||occult}, or {@skill Nature|} for {@trait Primal||primal}). Further attempts by the same caster get the same result as the initial check to disbelieve.
You can Cast this Spell on a creature, disguising all items and spell effects on it.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.targets: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct
entries: A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a {@spell Wall of Force|PC1|wall of force}), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter.

If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.
The damage increases by 2d10.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.targets: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item
entries: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, it becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

spells.name: Dispelling Globe
spells.area: 10-foot burst centered on one corner of your space
entries: You create an immobile globe around yourself. It attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into it, as if the globe were a {@spell Dispel Magic|PC1|dispel magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank. If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area are affected normally). You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

spells.name: Disperse into Air
spells.trigger: You take damage from an enemy or a hazard
entries: After taking the triggering damage, you transform into air. Until the end of the current turn, you can't be attacked or targeted, you don't take up space, you can't act, and any auras or emanations you have are suppressed. At the end of the turn, you re-form in any space you can occupy within 15 feet of where you were when you dispersed. Any auras or emanations you had are restored as long as their duration didn't run out while you were dispersed.

spells.name: Divine Decree
entries: You utter a potent litany from your faith, a mandate that harms those who oppose your ideals. You deal 7d10 spirit damage to your enemies in the area; each enemy must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute. If you're on your home plane and the creature is not, the creature is sent back to its home plane. A creature of 10th level or lower must also succeed at a Will save or be {@condition Paralyzed||paralyzed} for 1 minute; if it critically fails, it dies (this is a {@trait Death||death} effect).
The damage increases by 1d10, and the level of creatures that must attempt a second save on a critical failure increases by 2.

spells.name: Divine Immolation
entries: Divine flames scour creatures within the area. Creatures take 6d6 fire damage and 2d6 {@condition Persistent Damage||persistent fire damage}. The divine power within the flames scorches the spirit as well; a creature takes spirit damage instead of fire damage from divine immolation if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM).
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and persistent damage.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and double persistent damage.
The damage increases by 1d6 and persistent damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Divine Inspiration
entries: You infuse a target with spiritual energy, refreshing its magic. If it prepares spells, it recovers one 6th-rank or lower spell it previously cast today and can cast that spell again. If it spontaneously casts spells, it recovers one of its 6th-rank or lower spell slots. If it has a focus pool, it regains its Focus Points, as if it had Refocused.

spells.name: Divine Lance
entries: You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Divine Wrath
entries: You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and is {@condition Sickened||sickened} 1.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes full damage and is sickened 2; while it's sickened, it's also {@condition Slowed||slowed} 1.
The damage increases by 1d10.

spells.name: Dizzying Colors
entries: You unleash a swirling multitude of colors that overwhelms creatures based on their Will saves.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature is {@condition Dazzled||dazzled} for 1 round.
{@b Failure} The creature is {@condition Stunned||stunned} 1, {@condition Blinded||blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is stunned for 1 round and blinded for 1 minute.

spells.name: Dominate
entries: You take command of the target, forcing it to obey you. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is stunned 1 as it fights off your commands.
{@b Failure} You control the target. It gains the {@condition Controlled||controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.
{@b Critical Failure} As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.
The duration is unlimited.

spells.name: Downpour
entries: You call forth a torrential downpour, which extinguishes non-magical flames. Creatures in the area are {@condition Concealed||concealed} and gain fire resistance 10. Creatures outside the area are concealed to those inside the area. If a creature with weakness to water ends its turn in the area, the downpour triggers its weakness.
The fire resistance increases by 2.

spells.name: Dragon Form
entries: Calling upon powerful magic, you gain a Large dragon battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose one type of common dragon or another type to which your GM allows access. While in this form, you gain the {@trait Dragon||dragon} trait. You have hands in this battle form and can take {@trait Manipulate||manipulate} actions. You can Dismiss the spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
10 temporary Hit Points.
Speed 40 feet, fly 100 feet. You gain any of the following Speeds the chosen dragon has, but with the listed amount: burrow 20 feet, climb 40 feet, swim 60 feet.
Resistance 10 against the damage type of your Dragon Breath (see below).
Darkvision and imprecise scent 60 feet.

The following unarmed melee attacks, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +6. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the {@condition Enfeebled||enfeebled} condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead. See below for more on these attacks. {@b Melee} {@as 1} jaws, {@b Damage} 2d12 piercing plus 2d6 damage of the same damage type as your Dragon Breath (see below); {@b Melee} {@as 1} claw (agile), {@b Damage} 3d10 slashing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} tail (reach 10 feet), {@b Damage} 3d10 bludgeoning.
{@skill Athletics|} modifier of +23, unless your own is higher.

{@b Dragon Breath} {@as 2} You exhale deadly magical energy in an area, dealing 10d6 damage to each creature in the area with a basic save against your spell DC. The shape, damage type, and save type match that of your chosen dragon's breath. If the chosen dragon's breath can deal more than one type of damage, choose one when you cast {@i dragon form}. The shape is a 30-foot cone or a 100- foot line. Once activated, Dragon Breath can't be used again for 1d4 rounds. Dragon Breath has the tradition trait matching the type of dragon and the damage trait matching the type of damage it deals, if applicable.

{@b Tradition Resistance} If the dragon's magical tradition matches that of your {@i dragon form} spell, you gain the listed ability. {@b Arcane} resistance 5 against damage from spells; {@b divine} resistance 10 to spirit, vitality, and void; {@b occult} resistance 10 to mental; {@b primal} resistance 5 to physical damage.

Your battle form is Huge, you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, and your attacks have 10-foot reach (or 15-foot reach if they previously had 10-foot reach). You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +28, a damage bonus of +12, and Athletics +28. Your Dragon Breath deals an additional 4d6 damage.

spells.name: Dream Message
spells.targets: 1 creature you know by name and have met in person
entries: You send a message to your target's dream. The message is one-way, up to 1 minute of speech (roughly 150 words). If the target is asleep, they receive the message instantly. If not, they receive it the next time they sleep. As soon as they receive it, the spell ends, and you know the message was sent.
You can target up to 10 creatures you know by name and have met in person. You must send the same message to all of them; the spell ends for each creature individually.

spells.name: Dreamer's Call
spells.duration: until the end of the target's next turn
entries: You create a vivid, illusory daydream drawn from the images of the target's dreams. The daydream appears in an unoccupied space in range, and you attempt to draw the target toward it.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target's attention wavers. It becomes {@condition Fascinated||fascinated} by the daydream.

{@b Failure} The target is fascinated with the daydream and pursues a course of action you choose as its first action after you Cast the Spell: approach the daydream, run away from it (as the fleeing condition), Release what it's holding as an offering, or {@action Drop Prone|} in obeisance.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the target follows the course of action for as many actions as possible for the spell's duration, and does nothing else.

spells.name: Dreaming Potential
entries: You draw the target into a lucid dream where it can explore the endless possibilities of its own potential within the everchanging backdrop of its dreamscape. If it sleeps the full 8 hours uninterrupted, when it wakes, it counts as having spent a day of downtime retraining, though it can't use dreaming potential for any retraining that would require either an instructor or specialized knowledge it can't access within the dream.

spells.name: Duplicate Foe
entries: You create a temporary duplicate of an enemy to fight on your behalf. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to disrupt the spell. The duplicate appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and has the target's attack modifier, AC, saving throw modifiers, Perception, and skill modifiers, but it has only 70 Hit Points and lacks the target's special abilities, including immunities, resistances, and weaknesses. It has no magic items except {@i weapon potency} runes.

The duplicate gains the {@trait Minion||minion} trait, and it can only Stride and Strike. Its Strikes deal the target's normal damage but don't apply added effects, since it doesn't have special abilities. The spell automatically ends if the duplicate's Hit Points drop to 0.

The duplicate attacks your enemies to the best of its abilities. You can also try to give it additional instructions; when you Sustain the spell, you can also Command a Minion as part of your action, but the GM determines whether the duplicate follows your command.
The duplicate is unstable, so each turn after it takes its actions, it loses 4d6 Hit Points. It's not a living creature, and it can never regain its lost Hit Points in any way.
{@b Critical Success} You fail to create a duplicate.
{@b Success} The duplicate deals half damage with its Strikes and the duration is reduced to a maximum of 2 rounds.
{@b Failure} The duplicate works as described.
The level of creature you can target increases by 2. The duplicate has 10 more HP.

spells.name: Earthbind
entries: Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target falls safely up to 120 feet.
{@b Failure} The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't {@action Fly|}, {@spell Levitate|PC1|levitate}, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.
{@b Critical Failure} The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, {@i levitate}, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.

spells.name: Earthquake
entries: You shake the ground, topple creatures into fissures, and collapse structures. The GM might add additional effects in certain areas. Cliffs might collapse, causing creatures to fall, or a lake might drain as fissures open up below its surface, leaving a morass of quicksand.
{@b Shaking Ground} The ground is difficult terrain, and creatures on it take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, AC, and skill checks.

{@b Fissures} Each creature on the ground must attempt a Reflex save at the start of its turn to keep its footing and avoid falling into 40-foot-deep fissures that open beneath it. The fissures are permanent, and their sides require successful DC 15 {@skill Athletics|} checks to {@action Climb|}.

{@b Collapse} Structures and ceilings might collapse. The GM rolls a flat check for each (DC 16 for a sturdy structure, DC 14 for an average structure and most natural formations, DC 9 for a shoddy structure, all adjusted higher or lower as the GM sees fit). A collapse deals 11d6 bludgeoning damage to each creature caught in it with a basic Reflex save. A creature falls {@condition Prone||prone} unless it critically succeeds and falls into a fissure if it critically fails.
You create a massive earthquake that can devastate a settlement. The range increases to half a mile and the area to a quarter-mile burst.

spells.name: Earthworks
entries: With a ripple of earth, you raise small barriers from the ground. The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain. The spell's area is a 5-foot burst if you spent 1 action to cast it, a 10-foot burst if you spent 2 actions, or a 15-foot burst if you spent 3 actions. A creature can Interact to clear the barriers from one 5-foot square adjacent to it.
You pull the barriers to float in the air, causing the spell to function as difficult terrain for flying creatures.

spells.name: Eclipse Burst
entries: A globe of freezing darkness explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d4 void damage to living creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.
If the globe overlaps with an area of magical {@trait Light||light} or affects a creature affected by magical light, {@i eclipse burst} attempts to counteract the light effect.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and becomes {@condition Blinded||blinded} by the darkness for an unlimited duration.
The cold damage increases by 1d10 and the void damage against the living increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Electric Arc
entries: An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Elemental Betrayal
entries: Your patron uses its superior command of the elements, empowering them to undermine your foe. When you Cast this Spell, choose {@trait Air||air}, {@trait Earth||earth}, {@trait Metal||metal}, {@trait Fire||fire}, {@trait Water||water}, or {@trait Wood||wood}. The target gains weakness 2 to that trait.
Increase the weakness by 1.
